title: Hittite remains in underground cities show they were reused

tellings.quote: they found uh evidence of Hittites and evidence of um ancient cultures that are not like Ancient Ancient

plain: In the underground cities of Derinkuyu in Turkey, digs turned up traces of the Hittites, an ancient people of the region, and of other ancient cultures that were "not like Ancient Ancient," meaning not the oldest. A researcher named Matt LaCroix tells Michels this without naming a source. He takes it to mean those peoples reused the tunnels, so the cities themselves would be older than the people found in them.
